alert.vote_similarity_body.text: 本期未執行投票相似度，讀者的投票沒有作用，精選未經過濾就直接發布。嵌入 API 拒絕了請求：HTTP {$status} {$detail}。在嵌入金鑰或其權限修好之前，每次產生精選都會再發生。
alert.vote_similarity_body.source: Vote similarity did not run this period, so reader votes had no effect on this digest. The digest was published unfiltered. The embedding API refused the request: HTTP {$status} {$detail}. This repeats every run until the embedding key or its permissions are fixed.

digest.description.text: Cyris {$issue} 精選：從 {$received} 篇文章選出 {$included} 篇。

error.no_settings_store.text: 這個部署沒有可寫入的設定儲存區
error.no_settings_store.source: this deployment has no settings store to write

feed_check.already_listed.text: 清單中已有這個訂閱源，名稱為「{$name}」。
feed_check.already_listed.source: This feed is already in the list as {$name}.

feed_check.encoded.text: {$url} 回應了未要求的壓縮格式。請貼上訂閱源本身的網址。
feed_check.encoded.source: {$url} answered in a compressed form the check did not ask for. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.http_status.text: {$url} 回應 HTTP {$status}。請檢查網址，或改貼訂閱源本身的網址。
feed_check.http_status.source: {$url} answered HTTP {$status}. Check the address, or paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.no_articles.text: 訂閱源 {$url} 尚無文章，目前沒有內容可讀。
feed_check.no_articles.source: The feed at {$url} has no articles, so there is nothing to read from it yet.

feed_check.no_feed_link.text: 頁面 {$url} 未連結任何 RSS 或 Atom 訂閱源。請在網站上找到訂閱源本身的網址並貼上。
feed_check.no_feed_link.source: The page at {$url} links no RSS or Atom feed. Find the feed's own address on the site and paste that.

feed_check.not_a_feed.text: {$url} 不是 RSS 或 Atom 訂閱源。請貼上訂閱源的網址，或有連結訂閱源的網站首頁。
feed_check.not_a_feed.source: {$url} is not an RSS or Atom feed. Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page that links one.

feed_check.not_a_url.text: 請貼上以 http:// 或 https:// 開頭的網址。
feed_check.not_a_url.source: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.

feed_check.not_public.text: {$url} 位於私人或本機網路，檢查不會抓取這類網址。請貼上公開訂閱源的網址。
feed_check.not_public.source: {$url} is on a private or local network, which this check does not fetch. Paste a public feed's address.

feed_check.too_large.text: {$url} 回應的內容過大，不可能是訂閱源。請貼上訂閱源本身的網址。
feed_check.too_large.source: The answer from {$url} is too large to be a feed. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.too_many_redirects.text: {$url} 重新導向次數過多。請貼上訂閱源本身的網址。
feed_check.too_many_redirects.source: {$url} redirects too many times. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.unreachable.text: 無法連線到 {$url}（{$reason}）。請檢查網址後再試一次。
feed_check.unreachable.source: Could not reach {$url} ({$reason}). Check the address and try again.

index.description.text: Cyris 精選的所有期數，每期從 RSS 和電子報挑出值得讀的文章，由新到舊排列。
index.description.source: Every issue of a Cyris digest: the articles worth reading from a set of RSS feeds and newsletters, newest first.

index.empty.text: 還沒有任何一期精選。執行 {#code}cyris run{/code} 產生第一期。
index.empty.source: No digests yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} to generate your first digest.

index.interest.text: 到{#link}興趣地圖{/link}看你投票過的標籤。
index.interest.source: See the {#link}Interest map{/link} of the tags you vote on.

index.intro.text: Cyris 從 RSS 和電子報收集文章，挑出值得讀的編成精選，由新到舊排列。每一期包含精選，以及這期評選過的所有文章。
index.intro.source: Cyris collects articles from RSS feeds and newsletters and selects the ones worth reading into a digest. Newest first. Each issue has the digest and the full list of articles it judged.

interest.description.text: 你在 Cyris 投票過的文章所帶的標籤。一起出現的標籤會連成線，並標出每項沒興趣標記還剩多少時間。
interest.description.source: The tags of the articles you voted on in Cyris, joined where they appear together, with how much of each suppression clock is left.

interest.empty.text: 你投票過的文章都還沒有標籤。請在投票後執行 {#code}cyris run{/code}。
interest.empty.source: No voted article carries a tag yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} after you vote on articles.

interest.failed.source: Could not draw the interest map: {$reason}

interest.holds_elsewhere.text: 目前有標為沒興趣的文章，但都不在這張地圖的標籤附近。
interest.holds_elsewhere.source: Suppressions are active, but none is near a tag on this map.

interest.intro.text: 你投票過的文章所帶的標籤，一起出現的標籤會連成線。
interest.intro.source: The tags of the articles you voted on, joined where they appear together.

interest.legend.text: 亮：標為沒興趣；越暗：剩餘時間越少；淡色：未標為沒興趣。
interest.legend.source: Lit = suppressed now; dimmer = less time left; half colour = not suppressed.

interest.no_holds.text: 目前沒有標為沒興趣的文章。

interest.no_store.text: 興趣地圖要從 SQL 儲存區讀取投票和沒興趣標記，但本站的 [store] backend 不是 "sqlite" 也不是 "d1"。
interest.no_store.source: The interest map reads votes and holds from the SQL store: this deployment's [store] backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1".

issue.degraded.text: 本期有些步驟無法使用設定的 LLM，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。請到「設定」檢查供應商和金鑰。
issue.degraded.source: Some or all of this issue is unscored or plain excerpts: the configured LLM could not be used for every step this run. Check the provider and its key on Settings.

issue.empty.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。

issue.empty_raw.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。可在{#link}所有文章{/link}查看每一篇的評選結果。

issue.generated_by.text: 由 {#link}Cyris{/link} 產生 · {$tokens} 個 token · {$calls} 次 API 呼叫

labels.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
labels.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

labels.all_answered.text: 每一篇都已回答。請執行 cyris labels report 查看結果。
labels.all_answered.source: Every item is answered. Run cyris labels report for the result.

labels.hint.text: 往左滑選少看，往右滑選多看。點一下卡片，會在新分頁開啟文章。
labels.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

labels.lede.text: 每張卡片是一篇評選過的文章，但不顯示評選結果。想看更多類似文章就選「多看」，否則選「少看」。
labels.lede.source: Each card is an article the filter judged, without its verdict. Up if you want articles like it, down if not.

labels.not_drawn.text: 尚未抽樣。請先執行 cyris labels draw。
labels.not_drawn.source: No sample is drawn yet. Run cyris labels draw first.

labels.page_description.text: Cyris 盲標：一次顯示一篇抽樣文章，不附評選結果。
labels.page_description.source: Blind labels for a Cyris deployment: one sampled article at a time, without the pipeline's verdict.

labels.progress.text: 已回答 {$answered}／{$total} 篇 · 還剩 {$remaining} 篇

labels.signed_out.text: 登入已過期，回答未記錄。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
labels.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the answer was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

labels.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，回答可能未記錄。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
labels.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the answer may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.

mail.empty_raw_at.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。每一篇的評選結果見「所有文章」：{$url}

mail.footer_links.text: {#archive}過往精選{/archive} · {#settings}設定{/settings}（本信寄到「設定」裡填寫的信箱）
mail.footer_links.source: {#archive}Archive{/archive} · {#settings}Settings{/settings} — mail goes to the address set on Settings

mail.generated_by_cost.text: 由 {#link}Cyris{/link} 產生 · {$tokens} 個 token · {$calls} 次 API 呼叫 · 費用 ${$cost}
mail.generated_by_cost.source: Generated by {#link}Cyris{/link} · {$tokens} tokens · {$calls} api calls · cost ${$cost}

mail.kept.text: 從 {$sources} 個來源的 {$received} 篇文章中收錄 {$included} 篇。

mail.publish_failed.text: 線上版發布失敗，本期沒有網頁可以開啟。
mail.publish_failed.source: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no page to open.

mail.publish_failed_text.text: 線上版發布失敗，本期沒有連結。
mail.publish_failed_text.source: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no link.

mail.stats.text: {$sources} 個來源 · 收到 {$received} 篇 · {#b}收錄 {$included} 篇{/b}

notify.degraded.text: 精選品質下降：本期無法使用設定的 LLM，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。
notify.degraded.source: Degraded digest: the configured LLM could not be used this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.

notify.degraded_model.text: 精選品質下降：本期有些步驟無法使用 LLM {$model}，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。
notify.degraded_model.source: Degraded digest: LLM {$model} could not be used for every step this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.

notify.link_health.text: 抓到 {$synthetic} 封找不到原文連結的電子報；精選中有 {$dead} 則沒有可點的連結

raw.description.text: Cyris {$issue} 精選評選過的所有文章，依來源分組。
raw.description.source: Every article the {$issue} issue of a Cyris digest judged, grouped by source.

raw.hint.text: 往左滑選少看，往右滑選多看；選取卡片後，也可以按 ← 或 →。點一下卡片，會在新分頁開啟文章。
raw.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up; with the card focused, ← and → do the same. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

raw.intro.text: 本期評選過的所有文章，加上還待定的。精選只挑出其中一部分。
raw.intro.source: Everything the run decided on, plus what is still pending. The digest shows a selection of it.

raw.label.text: 所有文章 · {$articles} 篇 · {$sources} 個來源

vote.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
vote.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

vote.not_configured.text: 目前無法投票：app Worker 未設定 CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL。設定後請再投一次。
vote.not_configured.source: Voting is not set up here: the app Worker has no CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL. Set it, then vote again.

vote.refused.text: 投票失敗（HTTP {$status}），請再試一次。如果持續失敗，請檢查 promote Worker。
vote.refused.source: The vote did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the promote Worker.

vote.signed_out.text: 登入已過期，這次投票沒有記錄。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
vote.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the vote was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

vote.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，投票可能沒有記錄。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
vote.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the vote may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
